about.intro: CROWNED is a curated football-shirt destination — retro icons and current-season kits, selected with care and delivered across Israel.
about.body1: We started from a simple idea: the shirts that defined eras deserve better than a crowded marketplace. Every piece in the catalog is chosen for its story — a season, a final, a colorway people remember.
about.body2: Every order is prepared on demand: you choose the size, version and personalization, we handle production and keep you updated at every step until it reaches your door.

delivery.intro: We deliver across Israel through configurable delivery areas. Delivery is free from 3 qualifying items.

faq.intro: Quick answers about ordering, sizing, delivery and returns.
faq.a1: Orders are made to order. After the supplier dispatches, delivery takes roughly 10–14 days, plus local delivery time in your area.
faq.q2: How do I unlock free delivery?
faq.a2: Add 3 or more qualifying items to your order — it's based on the number of items, not the total.
faq.q3: Is the name and number really free?
faq.a3: Yes. Name and number personalization is free; an optional patch adds ₪5.
faq.a4: Check the size guide on every product page — charts differ between fan, player, retro, long-sleeve, hoodie and kids items. Player versions run slim.
faq.q5: Can I cancel or return my order?
faq.a5: Orders can be cancelled only before production starts. Because items are made to order, returns are generally not accepted for size mistakes or change of mind — see the full policy.
faq.q6: What if my order arrives damaged or wrong?
faq.a6: Contact us within 48 hours of delivery with clear photos and we'll review it and provide a replacement or another suitable solution where appropriate.
faq.a7: Currently by bank transfer (verified manually before production). More payment methods are coming.
faq.q8: How do I track my order?
faq.a8: Use the Track Order page with your order number plus the email or phone used at checkout.
